mina_ops: Quick flag - onboarding sampleapp shows intermittent empty vectors from rerank/embeddings when batcher helper retries. Node + Go show it, Python doesn't.

jules_sdk: Can you drop the request body and raw response? Are you using the sampleapp batcher?

mina_ops: Using sampleapp batcher. Minimal POST body: { model: rerank-lite-1, queries: [q], candidates: [[a,b]] }. Response sometimes has results [ {score, vector:[..]}, {score, vector:[] } ] or occasionally null entries. No error field.

harper_infra: Sounds like the auth refresh + retry path we discussed. If a token refresh happens mid-batch the retry wrapper can replay a fragment and client-side index zipper misaligns items -> empty/misplaced vectors.

jules_sdk: Short term: batcher should attach stable ids to each item and reassemble response by id, not by array index. Also SDKs should validate vector length and treat empty/missing as transient and retry whole batch once.

mina_ops: Confirmed locally: adding _id via nanoid() and remapping response by _id eliminated empty vectors in 2k runs.

harper_infra: Longer term: add single-flight auth refresh lock and make retry wrapper replay full batches. Filing INFRA-887.

docs-bot: Filed DOCS-510: "Embedding/rerank batching: empty vectors and retry semantics". Will add onboarding note and example snippet.

jules_sdk: Also flagging API inconsistency: embeddings returns "embedding" field, rerank returns "vector". That mismatch causes SDK mapping bugs; propose RFC to standardize field names.

mina_ops: Workaround for customers: set env BATCHER_SAFE_BY_ID=true for sampleapp and upgrade to patched SDKs. Leaving thread; will follow PR. :thumbsup:
